title: A novel statistical framework for quantifying risks and benefits of AI automation in screening mammography.
summary: Mirai scores on 114,229 screening mammograms support a clinically explicit rule-out threshold trade-off framework; thresholds and missed-cancer counts are reported, with hypothetical radiologist catch-up assumptions kept explicit.
ai_technology: Mirai risk scores from 114,229 cases; 0.20 threshold rules out 75% but yields 121 net additional missed cancers under the hypothetical 30% catch-up scenario; 0.05 yields 36% reduction and modeled zero net increase. Retrospective single-site 2006–2023 analysis; thresholds are illustrative, not a clinical recommendation.
